capabilities: Create Markdown-native fiction projects with a ten-step dashboard
Plan characters, scenes, and worldbuilding notes
Write and edit the manuscript as one continuous stream
Visualize scenes on corkboards, timelines, beat sheets, and relationship graphs
Track writing sessions, prose statistics, tasks, revisions, and foreshadowing
extras: Local-first with no account, AI service, telemetry, or internet requests. Screen recording and the local API are opt-in; the visualization workspace is limited to desktop and tablet.
motivation: The author built it to turn the Snowflake Method's iterative workflow into a focused, Markdown-native workspace instead of scattering summaries, character sheets, and scene plans across separate documents and spreadsheets.
problem: Fiction planning material is scattered across separate documents and spreadsheets, with no guided place to develop and draft a novel.
